title: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
Anthropic [Claude Haiku 5.5](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#claude-haiku-5-5) is now available on Unity Gateway. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
